population: B2B clean-train folds 0-3 (1421 queries); fold4=611, B2B581, internal300, development and confirmation sealed
threshold: Existing meets_fidelity(value, level), epsilon=1e-6; only attainable_levels are defined
trajectory: 12 distinct add-only packets, 13 prefixes including empty and full; V8 and projected V13 top10 use the same V8 relative packet order
window: Consecutive successful prefix states in one order; first window begins at first successful prefix, max window may start later; persistence means all remaining prefixes through full context succeed
lattice: Exact subset-DAG DP for existence and minimum starting tokens of a k-consecutive-success path (k=1,2,3); per-anchor ceilings can use different paths and do not imply one jointly deployable trajectory
candidate_pool: Per-query maximum over fixed V8 plus V13 top10 projected orders is an oracle envelope, not a deployable selector
decision: Describe paired quality/token/stability headroom; no numerical GO threshold or new model is selected on these data
